newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 20.28 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 20.28 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Tuesday, July 22, was fixed at 20.28 percent, down 12 basis points from 20.40 percent, the rate for July 21, Banco de Mexico said Monday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day. It is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Tuesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
